scope: All 32 E4 classification gaps in the frozen Census. Physical pages are counted from one. Each locator is paired with a byte-verified in-cutoff PDF. Benchmarks evidence for the stated classification decision, including competing hosts, fieldwork limited to a prospect, exit events and scope exclusions. No evaluated-arm predictions or retrieval ranks were used. Locators from earlier case review identified candidates; direct inspection removed pages that only listed project names or tenure. This is a retrospective reference recorded by a model reviewer with access to historical findings; it is neither independent human annotation nor an exhaustive search of every relevant page. UNJUDGED has no hit-rate denominator or negative label. CONTEXT_ONLY provides material for deciding a hold, not an admissible field value. No reviewer minutes were observed.
